Definition: from G5228 and G5312; to elevate above others, i.e. raise to the highest position:--highly exalt.
BiblicalUsage: The word hyperypsóō carries the sense of to exalt highly, to lift up above. In Philippians 2:9, the text says "Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hyperypsóō I do not force more than it gives: to exalt highly, to lift up above.
